main_result.evidence: The results show that the overall model in this paper is able to improve the mAP from 76.29 to 81.21% on the populated dataset and improve the detection speed from 70.14 to 82.87 FPS.

coder_notes: Images in NEU-DET (200x200) were padded with average grayscale pixels to 416x416 before 6:2:2 splitting so that defects occupy 1/4 of the relative area. Abstract has a typo stating '4.29%' improvement, whereas Table 1, Section 4.2.1, and Conclusion show 81.21 - 76.29 = 4.92%. Table 3 copies numbers from literature references (including classification accuracy of ResNet models listed under the mAP column).
